name: DrupalFit Report Export
description: Optional DrupalFit submodule that adds CSV, JSON, and printable-HTML ("PDF") export of a stored DrupalFit report via an export_type plugin system and a single download route.
library_dependencies: One of TCPDF, mPDF, or Dompdf is optional (detected in hook_requirements); when none is present the 'PDF' export falls back to printable HTML
project_description: DrupalFit Report Export is an optional submodule of DrupalFit. It adds an export_type plugin system and a single permission-gated download route that renders a stored fit_report_history report as CSV, JSON, or a printable HTML document (labelled 'PDF'). Three export_type plugins ship: CSV (a flattened, HTML-stripped one-row-per-finding table), JSON (the full report data structure), and PDF (a standalone HTML page mirroring the report page, using an installed PDF library such as TCPDF/mPDF/Dompdf if available, otherwise plain HTML). Additional formats can be added by other modules as export_type plugins.
